# Night measure — Abbott 2.348.0.0

Each row is one `Come again.` in `dist/day3/board.log`. Ahead and lateral are the COUNT line on that fence just before the sentence. A circle is `RIDEAI come again` on that fence before the jump. Jumped without a circle is a lie.

138 clear-round sentences were jumped with no circle. 29 of those were under 4 m off the line, including a lateral of 1.62 m. `hk_adv_001` fence 7 also has a real circle at 13.86 m, and fence 9 has one at 5.13 m. Tried lateral >= 4, then lateral >= 6. Both still speak on a fence she jumps with no circle (`hk_les_001` fence 2 at 6.79 m). 6.0 also dropped the 5.13 m line on fence 9; the circle still heard the sentence later, once she was wider. Not a third number. The sentence is back to this morning's ahead-or-straight-run test. The 1.6 m count line and the 11 m window were not changed.
